# Dark Moss

Dark Moss is a GitHub-inspired dark look with muted green accents for comfortable, low-contrast reading. It keeps a clean, minimal interface intended to reduce eye strain while mirroring familiar GitHub styling.

![Dark Moss screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sergey900553/obsidian_githublike_theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)
